focus.title: Focus areas
focus.intro: Three threads run through most of what I build. They overlap more than they look like they should.

areas.title: Decentralized identity
areas.body: Issuers, wallets, and verifiers built to the OID4VC family of specifications and ISO 18013-5/-7 — the standards behind mobile driving licences and EU digital identity wallets. The interesting work is rarely the happy path: it is selective disclosure, trust registries, revocation, and the stubborn business of making one vendor's wallet accept another vendor's credential without either side loosening its security model.

areas.title: Protocols and smart contracts
areas.body: Protocol design and implementation in Solidity and Sway, including lending markets and onchain reputation. I care most about the properties that cannot be retrofitted after launch: upgrade paths, invariants that hold under adversarial conditions, and failure behaviour that degrades safely rather than silently. Audits catch bugs; they do not fix an architecture that assumed nothing would ever go wrong.

areas.title: Systems and tooling
areas.body: The infrastructure that makes the above usable — Rust and Node backends, indexers, dashboards, CI, and the internal tooling nobody demos but everybody depends on. I would rather own a feature from the protocol layer through to the interface than hand it across three teams and negotiate the seams afterwards.

currently.title: Currently
currently.body: At Blockchain Lab:UM I work on EU-funded applied research where the deliverable is a working reference implementation rather than a report — standards-based identity infrastructure that has to interoperate with everyone else's. At Lutra Labs, which I co-founded in 2024, I run operations and still ship code: LutraID for digital identity issuance and verification, Swaylend on Fuel, Replicant Network, and endorse.fun.

lutra-id.description: LutraID is a compliant platform for issuing and verifying digital documents. It brings together issuer and verifier workflows, wallet-facing credential issuance, and standards-based verification flows for modern digital identity systems.

polycat.description: A private trading bot monorepo. Started as Polyarb — a Polymarket weather bot with a realtime dashboard for markets, orders, balances, and weather overlays — then pivoted into polycat: a cross-platform Kalshi ↔ Polymarket arbitrage bot targeting 15-minute BTC/ETH crypto markets, with a Rust arb runtime, Next.js dashboard, and TUI for positions, orders, and live activity.

pikvmarr.description: A native iOS app for controlling PiKVM devices over the local network. It stores server configs, trusts self-signed certificates on first use (TOFU), and exposes ATX power control — power on, force off, hard reset — with live power-state polling and session-cookie auth, including 2FA.

chilitrack.description: A chili plant growth monitoring app that captures images on a schedule, analyzes them with AI, and presents a timeline view of the plant's development. Features live streaming, daily AI-generated growth commentary, and weekly comparative analysis.

tossinger.description: Tossinger is a native iOS and macOS app that lets you quickly 'toss' content from anywhere - tweets, web pages, articles, links - into your personal collection to revisit and organize later on your preferred device.

replicant-network.description: A decentralized platform for AI model crowdfunding, development, and deployment.

swaylend.description: The first and leading lending protocol on Fuel Network. Utilizing FuelVM, written in Sway. Earn as you supply the base asset or supply collateral and borrow the base asset yourself.

lutra-dashboard.description: Lutra Labs dashboard for managing attendances, events, and more. Why use existing solutions when you can build your own?

cowork-maribor.description: Book a desk at Cowork Maribor. Custom product for a local coworking space.

endorse-fun.description: Endorse your favorite creators, builders, hackers and various other types of Web3 participants onchain. Whether they're known via ENS, Farcaster, or Lens, show your appreciation and help build a stronger community.

masca.description: A MetaMask snap, bringing decentralized identity capabilities to the MetaMask wallet. Manage your DIDs and VCs, choose where to store received credentials, and share customized VPs.

eductx-v2.description: Issue and receive educational Verifiable Credentials conforming to the latest W3C decentralized identity standards, and store them in Masca.

eductx-v1.description: Issue and receive on-chain verifiable educational microcertificates on consortium EduCTX EVM network. Your certificates are verifiable, encrypted, and stored on-chain.

eductx-moodle.description: Utilize EduCTX's (EduCTXv1 and EduCTXv2) decentralized identity capabilities in Moodle.
